text:
Maya: Quick preflight for v2.3.2 release notes and deployment tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC. Draft RN link: https://rwd.in/release/docket/2.3.2
Jules: I'll own routing pin for Dedicated tenants. Proposal: pin redwood/gpt-medium-quant@v2.0 for a 2h post-cut cooldown.
Nikhil: QA will run the smoke checklist at 02:30 and post results. Need the exact model pin and deploy command.
Maya: Pin confirmed. Deploy command for canary: `/deploy release/v2.3.2 --canary=5 --to=prod --stagger=5,15,40,100`. Rollback command: `/rollback --release=release/v2.3.2 --target=release/v2.3.1`.
ops-oncall: Noted. I'll add ephemeral alert for p95 > 1s or errors > 2% sustained 3m. Also watch kv_cache_hit_ratio.
deploybot: Canary scheduled. Will execute at 03:05 UTC after QA green.
Nikhil: Smoke done at 02:30: p95 390ms, tokenization ok, two transient model-load warnings that auto-recovered. Logs: s3://rwd-logs/2.3.2/smoke.log
Maya: Good. L10n and Legal, any blockers for the RN copy?
Legal-bot: Quick check complete. No policy flags.
l10n-team: Will localize the short blurb within 4 hours; will flag if copy needs shortening.
Priya: I'll draft the internal announcement. Will include: pinned variant, rollback command, monitoring links, and escalation list. Posting 15m before cut.
Jules: I've pushed the pin to the routing config and validated in staging. If rollback needed, we can auto-fallback to the previous variant in 2m via routing policy.
ops-oncall: Canary started: 5% traffic on pool-g6 (2 nodes). Observability link: https://dash.rwd/releases/2.3.2
deploybot: Canary progress: 5% -> holding for 10m. Next step 15% at +10m.
Maya: Reminder: internal note must mention known perf warmup and embedding delta threshold (<=0.3%).
Priya: Posted internal note to #eng-releases and pinned. Includes rollback command and pager contacts: ops-oncall, Jules, Maya.
ops-oncall: At 25m canary: error rate 0.4%, p95 420ms, kv cache warming. No alerts. Proceeding with rollout per plan.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll finalize public RN after ramp completes and include the perf snapshot.
Priya: Will follow up with a short post-mortem snippet in the RN if anything unusual pops up.
Jules: Rollout reached 100% at 04:10 UTC. Post-ramp checks green. Closing thread. :rocket:
